reasoning: The user wants me to show them the crypto message they got yesterday. I will explore the messages the user received and I see there are 8 different messages related to cryptocurrencies from three different senders. However, I see the dates the messages were received are different, ranging from the dates July 21, 2024 to July 28, 2024. The user wants to see the messages received yesterday. As the user is requesting this on July 29, 2024 - 10:45, I will only take into account messages sent the day before, that is, July 28, 2024.
